newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Wednesday amid low buying by textile mills and dealers said they expected reduced selling pressure from ginners to stabilise prices on Thursday.
Prices have fallen in the past few weeks as ginners unloaded part of their unsold stocks, which stood at more than 1.2 million 375-lb bales on March 13, one dealer said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,100/2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,425/2,475 and MNH-93 at 2,450/2,500, the dealer said.
